meta.title: How It Works | MyJudicial
meta.description: Learn how to find, consult, and hire verified legal experts on MyJudicial in four simple steps.

hero.title: Legal help, simplified.
hero.subtitle: From finding the right specialist to securely paying for services, we've streamlined the entire legal process.

steps.title: Four steps to resolve your legal issue

step1.title: 1. Find or Match
step1.text: Browse our directory of verified experts by practice area, or describe your issue to our AI Assistant to get matched with the right specialist instantly.

step2.title: 2. Compare & Choose
step2.text: Review profiles, verified credentials, client ratings, and clear upfront pricing. No hidden fees or surprises.

step3.title: 3. Book Securely
step3.text: Select a time that works for you and pay securely via Mobile Money (MoMo). Your payment is held in escrow until the consultation is complete.

step4.title: 4. Consult & Review
step4.text: Meet with your lawyer via secure video call or in person. After the session, leave a review to help others in the community.

payment.title: Secure Payments & Escrow
payment.text: Your financial security is our priority. When you book a consultation, your payment is held securely in our escrow system. The lawyer only gets paid after your consultation is successfully completed. If the lawyer doesn't show up, you get a full refund.
payment.momo: We accept MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money for seamless transactions across Rwanda.
